finished_photo_observations.branches: Three nested rounded U-shaped paired branch forms spring from three separate ornamented stem junctions. End segments rise near vertically. Preserve smooth continuous curves and generous negative spaces; no straight diagonal-branch substitution.
finished_photo_observations.section: Branches show broad reflective front bands with narrow edge highlights; exact section/depth cannot be recovered from this view. Do not default silently to thin circular tubes.
finished_photo_observations.central_stem: Straight vertical faceted-looking shaft, visibly substantial rather than wire-like; three spaced collar/knop junctions, lower ornament group and separate lower shaft above the base.
finished_photo_observations.upper_groups: Seven similarly sized ornament stacks terminate at approximately one horizontal lamp level. Each presents flared goblet-like tiers below a broad decorated knop and an upward flower supporting the lamp.
finished_photo_observations.lamps: Seven broad shallow covered-looking gold lamp forms with small raised top details in this display photograph. Exact lid/nozzle/wick geometry and display-versus-service fittings require close-up verification. Do not substitute candles or add a shamash.
finished_photo_observations.base: Visible gold base is a broad, stepped, polygonal plinth with raised ornamental panels, under a circular-looking stem collar. At least two stepped tiers are visible; rear outline, exact polygon count and bottom contact are not established by this partially occluded view. Do not replace it with a generic tripod merely because a separate schematic discusses three feet.
finished_photo_observations.surface: Glossy warm gold with broad coherent highlights and fine relief ornament, not orange emissive plastic. Fine relief motifs remain unclassified at available resolution.

normalized_photo_fit_targets.status: Approximate visual estimates from one perspective photograph; authoring guides only, not measured artifact proportions

normalized_photo_fit_targets.uncertainty: Ratios are intentionally low precision. Use symmetry for original construction, then compare matched-perspective renders; do not report these as survey dimensions or lock them before review.
